prompt:
# Complete Updated Screener Specification

Screen active NIFTY 200 members on every completed 5-minute candle for either a short or a long setup. All conditions within a setup must hold.

Short: high(t0) > SMA20(t0), SMA50(t0), SMA200(t0); close(t0) < all three SMAs.

Long: close(t0) > open(t0); open(t0) < SMA20(t0), SMA50(t0), SMA200(t0) and close(t0) > all three SMAs; volume(t0) > volume(t-1).

Both setups require previous SuperTrend between the current candle's low and high, inclusive. Use the stored platform defaults: SMA20 (20), SMA50 (50), SMA200 (200), and SuperTrend (period 10, multiplier 3).

If multiple stocks match at 09:15 IST, retain only the highest-liquidity opening stock. Liquidity is average daily volume / (1 + average daily relative range), using the preceding liquidity_days trading sessions (default 10), excluding the signal day. Later candles remain eligible for all stocks. Return one highest-volume eligible candle per stock/date, breaking ties by latest candle time. Total counts unique matching stock/date pairs before ranking/capping.

The default date range is the latest 60 trading sessions, processed date by date. Accept inclusive from_date/to_date, at most 90 calendar days, as_of replay (IST candle OPEN timestamp), and comma-separated symbols intersected with live NIFTY 200. Replay includes the target candle after completion, never later OPEN timestamps; live scans exclude unfinished candles.

Present a ranked table with Symbol, Date, Last price (LTP), Volume, Candle time, Avg volume (20), SMA 20, SMA 50, SMA 200, and SuperTrend. Order dates descending, then volume descending by default. Limit to 10 rows per date with numbered pagination, symbol search, and sortable columns.

Acceptance loads the unchanged chart-evidence/cbcf05d6839f/acceptance_cases.json fixture against real history: COLPAL must match 2026-10-30 09:15 IST and BAJFINANCE must match 2026-10-13 09:15 IST on interval 5. Record measured conditions and actual rows in ACCEPTANCE_REPORT_PATH (default acceptance_report.json); never special-case symbols or dates.
